source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: كان في أخوين، الكبير اسمه أحمد والصغير محمود.
sentences.en: There were two brothers, the elder named Ahmad and the younger Mahmoud.

sentences.ar: لما توفى أبوهم، ترك إلهم أرض وبيت.
sentences.en: When their father passed away, he left them land and a house.
They started arguing over who would take what.

sentences.ar: كل واحد كان بدو الأرض الأحسن.
sentences.en: Each one wanted the better land.

sentences.ar: الخناق زاد، وصاروا ما يحكوا مع بعض.
sentences.en: The dispute grew, and they stopped talking to each other.
The whole family was saddened by the situation.

sentences.ar: محمود سمع الخبر ونسي كل الخناق.
sentences.en: Mahmoud heard the news and forgot all the fighting.

sentences.ar: ركض على المستشفى وقعد جنب أخوه.
sentences.en: He ran to the hospital and sat next to his brother.

sentences.ar: أحمد فتح عيونه وشاف أخوه، فبكى.
sentences.en: Ahmad opened his eyes and saw his brother, and he cried.

sentences.ar: قال: سامحني يا أخوي، الدنيا ما بتسوى خناق.
sentences.en: He said: forgive me, brother, the world isn't worth fighting over.

sentences.ar: محمود حضنه وقال: إنت أغلى من كل الأرض.
sentences.en: Mahmoud hugged him and said: you are more precious than all the land.

sentences.ar: من هديك اليوم، رجعوا متل ما كانوا.
sentences.en: From that day, they went back to how they used to be.
They divided the land fairly and without fighting.

sentences.ar: تعلموا إنه الدم ما بيصير مي.
sentences.en: They learned that blood doesn't turn to water.
